gameDescriptionHtml:
Become an alchemist in Diamond City, where growing a business means growing your own workers. Farm, craft, and sell your creations as you build relationships and navigate a dark fantasy story with multiple endings.

  • Build Your Alchemy Business: Grow magical crops, craft valuable goods, and put your homegrown workforce to work.
  • Meet the City’s Unusual Residents: Discover over 40 NPCs and relationship paths for six central heroines.
  • Shape the City’s Fate: Earn the trust of six factions and explore branching stories shaped by your choices and reputation.

Grow ingredients, turn them into valuable creations, and sell them to fund your next expansion. Along the way, fulfill orders, build relationships, and uncover the city’s stranger side.

Cultivate the Extraordinary
Grow over 100 crops and experiment with traits to improve your harvests. Expand underground and use alchemical circles to build a flourishing, self-sustaining farm.

Turn Curiosities into Profit
Decorate your shop and stock its shelves with crops, potions, and rare curiosities. Build your reputation to attract non-human customers and unlock lucrative special orders.

Grow Your Own Workforce
Meet the Peoplesprouts: workers you grow yourself. Assign them to farming, retail, and manufacturing to automate your business.

Match their talents to the job—and give them time to recover. Overwork takes a toll on their Sanity.

Turn Experiments into Opportunity
Transform materials into valuable goods or grant your Peoplesprouts powerful abilities. Experiment with volatile elements and combine alchemy with Oracles to discover extraordinary results.

Borrow the Power of Ancient Gods
Collect and combine divine blessings for powerful bonuses during each time rewind. Just beware of the gods behind them—and the influence of their whispers.

Decide Who to Trust
Win the favor of six rival factions to unlock special orders and new story possibilities. Your reputation and choices help determine how Diamond City’s story ends.

Oracle Summons
Try your luck summoning blessings from Ancient and Outer Gods. Their gifts could be just what your next experiment needs.
